changes.title: Ed house default
items: Ed's treehouse arrangement is now the default. Add ?layout=classic to use the previous layout.

changes.title: Watch fade
items: Wild creatures’ red warning now fades away more slowly.

changes.title: Paused journal recovery
items: Reloading or closing the tab no longer reports an unexpected session end.
Paused input frames are summarised instead of logged one by one. Routine log entries are capped; warnings and errors are kept.
Opening a link to a different night now says so plainly, keeps your saved night, and gives you a "Resume saved night" link straight back to it.
Playtest logging no longer queues repeated writes while browser storage is busy.
